description: Predict 10-year risk for 10 conditions from biomarker data: Type 2 Diabetes, Chronic Kidney Disease, Cardiovascular Disease, NAFLD/MASLD, Metabolic Syndrome, Hypothyroidism, Anemia, Insulin Resistance, Vitamin D Deficiency, and Inflammation/Autoimmune. Returns risk tier (low/moderate/high/critical) and driving factors for each condition. Costs 15 credits per call.

demographic_context.description: Optional demographic context for more accurate risk stratification

sex.description: Biological sex for reference range adjustment
